name: Wall Street Poker
summary: Stud poker variant where players buy priced community cards from a Wall Street board.
rules_text: All players ante and receive three hole cards, two down and one up. Four community cards are dealt face-up in a row called the Wall Street, priced left to right at 1, 2, 3, 4 units. Action starts with the strongest board showing. On a turn a player may either take a free up-card from the deck or pay the price of any Wall Street card into the pot to take it; a purchased Wall Street card is immediately replaced from the deck. This repeats until each player has four up-cards. Each cycle is followed by a betting round, with bring-in rules in ante versions. Finally each player receives one down-card and a final betting round occurs. Best five-card poker hand from seven cards wins the pot.
rating_reason: Stud plus community cards poker, strategic.
